title: Housing on lots less than 100m2 merit assessment criteria
text: M2.10.1 Housing on lots less than 100m2 are integrated with the streetscape and surrounding development and does not form the predominant housing type in a street. M2.10.2 Housing on lots less than 100m2 are designed to a high standard to contribute to the desired streetscape character and minimise adverse impacts on the amenity of adjoining properties.
